note: Illustrative assumptions for what a decode-layer speedup is worth at scale. Edit them; scripts/results.py recomputes results/README.md. The speedups come from the judge.

layer_share_of_step.why: Share of a decode step's GPU time in the per-layer kernels that muse_decode_layer covers; the rest is communication (all-reduce), sampling and scheduling.

decode_share_of_serving.why: Share of serving GPU time spent decoding rather than prefilling.

gpus.why: H200-class GPUs serving the model: scenarios, since Meta publishes no fleet figure for 2026.

utilization.why: Fraction of each GPU-hour spent serving.

gpu_hour_usd.why: H200 rental market median per GPU-hour (GMI Cloud's 2026 guide); an owner's cost is lower, a hyperscaler's on-demand price higher.

requests_per_day.why: Meta AI passed 1 billion monthly users in May 2025 (Zuckerberg, shareholder meeting); about one request per user per day.

ms_per_output_token.why: Decode time per token per request at serving batch sizes.
